name: team_planning_forecast
description: List the forecast rows of a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in: what the plan's forecast rules assume about the scenario's period, beyond the changes it plans. Each row names its kind (the rule that made it), its unit (null for none) and cost centre, the step it covers (the scenario's period), the headcount it adds or takes away, its cost per currency and its capacity per model. Attrition takes away the seats its leavers leave empty until their time to hire has passed, including seats an earlier step's leavers left empty that are still empty in this step, counting filled seats only, never an open position, a placeholder or a planned leaver, and priced at the unit's average filled seat as the caller sees pay. These rows are the forecast part of team_planning_cost and team_planning_capacity, beside their actual part, which means the baseline's figure, not actual pay. A row has no id and is not a change: it can't be pinned, cleared, noted or listed among the changes; change the rule to change it. The plan's own id, Today, has no period and so no rows. Figures are decimal strings. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan; the plan's id gives no rows.
